reviewed_contracts.entry: A candidate is not adoption. The explicit root parent adoption must bind the exact controller/test/candidate and passed trainer/evaluator reviews. Complete prior score/Q status, actual diagnostic result and independent complete diagnostic result review must all report scientific training_gate_passed exactly true; false/null cannot enter. Review hashes bind prior adoption/status/locks/result/costs/score records, and prior recorded processes must have exited.
reviewed_contracts.source_and_model_integrity: All prior locked bytes are inherited unchanged. Complete current source inventory, original336/runtime9, full base model and starting canonical adapter inventory are rechecked between stages. Every completed trained adapter is checked for added/deleted files before and after subsequent stages; locked hashes detect changed bytes. Four distinct actual adapter directories plus common token audit and reviewed final training states are locked and validated before any seen48 evaluation.
reviewed_contracts.training: Actual trainer CLI passes the same initial canonical adapter, complete selection directory, original BC and correct per-arm labels. The common score-to-SFT token/context audit precedes all training. Reviewed trainer supplies fixed same-index 4BC+4recovery schedule, 100 new updates, 400+400 exposures, trainable existing adapter and fresh optimizer. Controller checks all800 forward/backward pairs,100 step metrics, exact target totals, finite losses, final-only inventory and matching audit/schedule/protocol. Loss is used solely for technical validation and never for checkpoint or scientific success selection.
reviewed_contracts.resource_and_process_ownership: All eight worker stages are serial physicalGPU2 launches through launch_gpu.py using project Python. System Python requires pidfd support. Spawn-to-start-tick capture is signal-blocked; termination/timeout enters owned-session cleanup, with no retry. Global Unix/monotonic deadline inherits the original171840-second study clock, including waits/hash checks, with30-second cleanup reserve. Audit ceiling1800seconds; each training/evaluation ceiling7200seconds. No unseen stage exists.
reviewed_contracts.cost_lineage: Shared environment/generation/scoring counters start at the actual completed diagnostic totals and chain all four evaluations without a reset or duplicate scoring charge. Stage and global ceilings and started/completed equality are checked. All192 trace/event streams later independently reconcile evaluation steps, generated tokens and policy calls. Training forward/backward/update and input/target/prompt exposure totals are reported separately, preserving differing label lengths rather than claiming equal compute.
reviewed_contracts.complete_result_barrier: Controller accepts each evaluation using technical metadata and byte hashes only. All eight stages must exit successfully and all four48-task evaluation outputs must be complete and locked before finalize reads any episode/event outcomes. The durable unblinding marker is written before the first outcome read. Validation checks exact fixed48 order, actual raw terminal/won state, unrepaired raw completion, admissibility, causal context, token totals and complete event-stream equality before computing paired comparisons.
reviewed_contracts.missingness_and_decision: Any technical or budget failure produces192 null outcome cells, null contrasts and null practical-screen flag. It preserves whether outcome reading started, completed cumulative costs and available interrupted worker cost ledger; a previously written provisional result lock is invalidated. Complete scientific failure remains false rather than null. The screen exactly requires reference>=3/48 additional successes versus both equally trained recovery controls and strictly greater success than frozen BC. It reports all four counts, paired gains/losses, six family and scene denominators, and never auto-launches further experiments.

practical_limits: This is a source/interface and pure-fixture implementation review, not an acquisition/diagnostic/learning result review or permission to deploy or launch.

No live process termination, actual GPU/model/tokenizer, simulator, or future remote inventory was exercised. Those identities, byte hashes and resources remain runtime adoption and postqueue verification requirements.
Successful metadata and stored transitions can establish internal evidence consistency; they do not replace real simulator execution or independent complete-result review.
Interrupted work may have unknown cost after a durable started record. The controller preserves available logs/receipts and does not claim completed-stage totals account for all interrupted work.
